children: may retest support at $4,342 per ounce, a break below which could open the way toward the $4,281-$4,297 range.

A series of retracements on the downtrend from $4,696 to $4,281 keeps controlling the market. The bounce triggered by the 14.6% level of $4,342 is likely to end around $4,379, as it looks like a pullback toward a bearish pennant.
The pattern suggests a target of $4,297. Considering that the preceding fall from $4,696 adopted a five-wave mode, a zigzag might be developing.
This wave pattern indicates a fall toward $4,100. A break above $4,379 would lead to a gain to $4,440. A further gain could invalidate the bearish outlook.

On the daily chart, a neutral zone of $4,306-$4,529 has been defined by the bounce from Sept. 2 to Sept. 3. Trending signals will become clearer when the metal gets out of it. The bias appears toward the downside, as suggested by the readings on the hourly chart.
